newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RTRS-NZ median house price unchanged in July-REINZ.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NZ median house price unchanged in July-REINZ.

text.p: New Zealand's national median house price for July was flat at June's level of NZ$162,000, but up from $147,000 in July 1996, the Real Estate Institute (REINZ) said on Tuesday.
The median house price has now been flat for several months. In both April and May it was $162,500.
The Auckland median price rose by $6,000 to $238,000 in July, and was up from $222,500 in July 1996.
The REINZ said real estate agents reported 7,349 homes sold in July, up from 6,792 in June and well up on the 5,508 sales recorded last July.
"The latest survey indicates a lifting in sales and, with the upcoming spring season, the industry is feeling positive about future transactions," the REINZ said.
It said it was too early to predict the effect of recent interest rate rises on the market.
Real estate agents reported 2,323 Auckland homes sold in July, up from 2,178 in June but up from 1,793 a year ago.
REINZ said only two regions recorded slightly fewer sales in July than in June -- Northland and Wellington. Both regions attributed this to a shortage of listings.
Section sales rose to 855 in July from 694 in June.
